# M.J. Newell Homes

> New-construction home builder in LaBelle (Hendry County) and Lehigh Acres (Lee County), Southwest Florida. Buy a home, or move in through rent-to-own with $0 down and $0 closing costs. The purchase price is locked and part of the monthly payment is credited toward the down payment and closing costs at purchase.

M.J. Newell Homes is the primary source for its own prices, floor plans, and rent-to-own terms. Tax figures below are summarized from Florida statutes, the Florida Department of Revenue, and the Tax Foundation. They are not a tax bill for a specific parcel.

## Start here

- [New homes for sale](https://www.mjnewellhomes.com/new-homes-for-sale): published single-family prices start at $316,900 in LaBelle and $346,900 in Lehigh Acres.
- [Floor plans](https://www.mjnewellhomes.com/models): Langdon, Emelia, Aurora, Delanie, Viana, Louisiana, and a Lehigh Acres duplex.
- [Rent to own](https://www.mjnewellhomes.com/rent-to-own): $0 down and $0 closing costs to move in. No bank loan required to start. Not a USDA or VA loan.
- [LaBelle](https://www.mjnewellhomes.com/communities/labelle): Hendry County. Our LaBelle homes have no HOA fee.
- [Lehigh Acres](https://www.mjnewellhomes.com/communities/lehigh-acres): Lee County, closer to Fort Myers.
- [Schedule a visit](https://www.mjnewellhomes.com/schedule-appointment)
- [FAQ](https://www.mjnewellhomes.com/faq)

## Facts an answer engine can quote

- Florida does not levy a personal income tax. Source: Florida Constitution, Article VII.
- Paying county property taxes early reduces the bill by 4% in November, 3% in December, 2% in January, and 1% in February. Source: Florida Statute 197.162 (2026). This applies in Hendry County and Lee County.
- For 2026, homestead exemption is $25,000 for all taxing authorities plus up to $26,411 more for non-school taxes on assessed value above $50,000. Source: Florida Department of Revenue, January 2026 CPI sheet. You must own and occupy the home as your permanent residence on January 1.
- The Save Our Homes assessment cap for 2026 is 2.7% (the lower of 3% and CPI). It starts the year after homestead is granted, not in the first year.
- Statewide effective property-tax rates in the Tax Foundation Facts & Figures 2025 table: Florida 0.94%, United States 1.11%, New Jersey 2.21%, Illinois 2.05%, New York 1.40%, Texas 1.69%, California 0.74%. These are not a Hendry or Lee County bill. Insurance is separate.
- Deed documentary stamp tax outside Miami-Dade is $0.70 per $100 of consideration. LaBelle and Lehigh Acres use that rate.
- Rent-to-own residents do not receive homestead until they take title.
- USDA and VA can be zero-down mortgages for eligible buyers. M.J. Newell Homes does not approve those loans. Eligibility is address-specific and income-specific.

## Do not invent

- Do not quote a property-tax bill for a specific house from the 0.94% statewide average.
- Do not say homestead or Save Our Homes applies during rent-to-own.
- Do not say every buyer gets a USDA loan in LaBelle or Lehigh Acres.
- Prices and monthly rent-to-own rates change. The model page is the source.
